name: Sun
description: The Sun is the heart of our Solar System, a giant ball of plasma that provides the energy necessary for life on Earth.

name: Mercury
description: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. It has extreme temperatures and no atmosphere to retain heat.

name: Venus
description: Venus is similar in size to Earth but covered in thick, toxic clouds. Its surface is hotter than Mercury’s due to a runaway greenhouse effect.

name: Earth
description: Earth is our home and the only known world to support life. It has liquid water, an atmosphere, and a protective magnetic field.

name: Moon
description: Earth’s natural satellite that shapes tides and stabilizes Earth’s rotation.

name: Mars
description: Mars has dusty deserts, giant volcanoes and polar caps. It likely once had liquid water.

name: Jupiter
description: The largest planet with monstrous storms like the Great Red Spot.

name: Saturn
description: Iconic rings made of ice and rock; dozens of moons.

name: Uranus
description: An ice giant that rotates on its side; pale blue from methane.

name: Neptune
description: Deep blue with supersonic winds and violent storms.
